scope: Sources cited or cross-checked for the Color Atlas guide; roles distinguish algorithm origins, dataset lineage, API references and documentation design.

sources.title: A perceptual color space for image processing
sources.author: Björn Ottosson
sources.used_for: Definition of OKLab/OKLCh, conversion coefficients, perceptual editing and interpolation. This is the author’s technical article, not a journal paper.
sources.guide: Definition of OKLab and the conversion matrices used for editing and Smooth blending.

sources.title: CSS Color Module Level 4
sources.author: W3C CSS Working Group
sources.used_for: sRGB conversion, OKLab/OKLCh definitions, interpolation-space choices and chroma-reduction gamut mapping.
sources.guide: sRGB transfer functions, OKLab/OKLCh and guidance on interpolation spaces and gamut mapping.

sources.title: Final Report of the O.S.A. Subcommittee on the Spacing of the Munsell Colors
sources.author: Sidney M. Newhall, Dorothy Nickerson and Deane B. Judd
sources.used_for: Historical publication behind the renotation dataset. JOSA 33(7), 385–418. The app uses the distributed data and checks the neutral-value relation against the reference implementation; it does not reconstruct the visual experiment.
sources.guide: Origin of the 1943 renotation: the Munsell samples behind the Munsell example and its Value scale.

sources.title: A Physiologically-based Model for Simulation of Color Vision Deficiency
sources.author: Gustavo M. Machado, Manuel M. Oliveira and Leandro A. F. Fernandes
sources.used_for: Source model for the color-vision simulation matrices. IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics 15(6), 1291–1298.

sources.title: Munsell Renotation Data
sources.author: RIT Munsell Color Science Laboratory
sources.used_for: Source of the real.dat xyY samples, Illuminant C / 2° observer convention and 0.975 luminance correction. Renotation coordinates are not direct measurements of the bundled screen previews.
sources.guide: The xyY samples (Illuminant C, 2° observer) converted to the sRGB chips of the Munsell example.

sources.title: Colour — MUNSELL_COLOURS
sources.author: Colour Developers
sources.used_for: Cross-check of the renotation dataset and its luminance convention; the app’s data generator is local code rather than a runtime dependency on Colour.

sources.title: Colour — Bradford chromatic adaptation transform
sources.author: Colour Developers
sources.used_for: Reference matrix for the Illuminant C → D65 Bradford adaptation used by the Munsell data generator. This reference does not introduce a new adaptation method.
sources.guide: Bradford adaptation from Illuminant C to D65 used to convert the Munsell samples to sRGB.

sources.title: Colour — luminance_Newhall1943
sources.author: Colour Developers; method attributed to Newhall, Nickerson and Judd
sources.used_for: Reference for the Munsell Value-to-luminance polynomial used for neutral samples, with the app’s separate 0.975 scaling and endpoint handling.

sources.title: Unity — GradientMode.PerceptualBlend
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.used_for: Native OKLab interpolation selected by perceptual Unity C# export.
sources.guide: Native OKLab gradient mode used by the Perceptual Unity export.

sources.title: Unity — Gradient.colorSpace
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.used_for: Color-space declaration for PerceptualBlend. Color Atlas exports decoded linear-sRGB keys and sets ColorSpace.Linear.

sources.title: Unity — Gradient.SetKeys
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.used_for: Gradient color/alpha key limits and SetKeys usage; the app preserves larger ramps through its JSON fallback.
sources.guide: Gradient key limits behind the JSON fallback.

sources.title: Unity — Working with linear textures
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.used_for: sRGB decoding and linear texture import behavior used in the engine integration guidance.

sources.title: Curve Atlases in Unreal Engine Materials
sources.author: Epic Games
sources.used_for: CurveLinearColor / Curve Atlas workflow referenced as an integration option. Color Atlas JSON is descriptive data, not a native asset importer.
sources.guide: Curve atlases and CurveLinearColor as an Unreal alternative to the PNG.

sources.title: HTML Standard — Canvas, downloads and dialog
sources.author: WHATWG
sources.used_for: Browser APIs underlying canvas PNG encoding, the download attribute and the native export dialog. These are implementation references checked for the guide.

sources.title: Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification, Third Edition
sources.author: W3C
sources.used_for: Format reference for exported PNG images. The app’s dimensions, sampling and canvas precision limits are verified from its implementation.

sources.title: Compositing and Blending Level 1
sources.author: W3C
sources.used_for: Reference for screen blending used in preview bloom. The app’s thresholds, strengths and repeated passes are app-specific choices.

sources.title: Filter Effects Module Level 1
sources.author: W3C
sources.used_for: Reference for blur filter semantics; the preview’s blur radii are chosen by the app.

sources.title: Motion — animate()
sources.author: Motion project
sources.used_for: Reference for the animate() call shape. From v0.90.16 the app embeds work/atlas-motion-lite.js, a Web Animations API implementation of the calls it makes, validated against Motion 14 timing; the Motion bundle is no longer shipped.

sources.title: Media Queries Level 5 — prefers-reduced-motion
sources.author: W3C
sources.used_for: Platform preference used to reduce automatic and interaction motion.

sources.title: EmberGen documentation
sources.author: JangaFX
sources.used_for: Reference for the wiki-like documentation structure requested for Color Atlas. It is not the source of Color Atlas’s color equations or reference simulation.

sources.title: Interaction of Color — contextual teaching and One Color Becomes Two
sources.author: Josef Albers; Josef & Anni Albers Foundation
sources.used_for: Inspiration for ColorPlay’s read-only context experiments and attention to color relationships. Candidate construction, OKLab metrics, thresholds and ranking are original Color Atlas heuristics, not formulas authored or validated by Albers.

links.label: Foundation — Interaction of Color teaching approach
Foundation — One Color Becomes Two exercise

sources.guide: Inspiration for ColorPlay and its Compare view.

sources.title: Clipboard writing and selection-copy compatibility
sources.author: MDN Web Docs contributors
sources.used_for: Clipboard.writeText success/rejection and secure-context requirements; deprecated Document.execCommand selection-copy behavior. The synchronous compatibility route, visible manual dialog and feedback policy are Color Atlas implementation choices.

sources.title: A Model of Saliency-Based Visual Attention for Rapid Scene Analysis
sources.author: Laurent Itti, Christof Koch and Ernst Niebur
sources.used_for: Multiscale feature contrast and inhibition of return. Color Atlas is an adaptation with different channels, filters and spatial selection, not the published model.
sources.guide: Multiscale contrast and inhibition of return, adapted for the attention overlay.

sources.title: Frequency-Tuned Salient Region Detection
sources.author: Radhakrishna Achanta, Sheila Hemami, Francisco Estrada and Sabine Süsstrunk
sources.used_for: Global color-distance idea. The paper uses CIELAB; Color Atlas uses OKLab and a blended multiscale score, with app-specific alpha handling.
sources.guide: Global color-distance term, adapted (OKLab instead of CIELAB) for the attention overlay.

sources.title: SaliencyToolbox — centerSurround.m
sources.author: Dirk B. Walther and California Institute of Technology
sources.used_for: Inspected scale difference and exclusion-mask handling. Used as a conceptual cross-check only; no MATLAB or repository code is copied, ported or bundled.

sources.title: Compositing and Blending Level 1
sources.author: W3C CSS Working Group
sources.used_for: Separable blend formulas and source-over alpha. Linear-sRGB image blending, bounded Add, layer UI and local persistence are Color Atlas choices.
sources.guide: Separable blend formulas and source-over alpha used by the layer stack.

sources.title: INPI basic trademark guide
sources.author: Instituto Nacional da Propriedade Industrial
sources.used_for: Scope of editorial naming review: the guide recommends prior database searches for similar marks. No per-name trademark clearance was performed. Neutral visual labels, grouping choices and compatibility identifiers are app editorial decisions.

sources.title: SVG filter effects — feTurbulence
sources.author: W3C
sources.used_for: SVG Perlin fractal noise and animated baseFrequency. Broad grayscale patches, a 65-sample OKLab map at L=0.07–0.28, 1.35-second presentation, early visibility guard, covered warmup and load-gated reveal are app choices. No external artwork or library code is bundled.

sources.title: User artwork
sources.author: User
sources.used_for: Loading art/layout and TEMP_PresetDesign.jpeg preview; user assets, not technical evidence.

sources.title: Texture Asset Editor in Unreal Engine
sources.author: Epic Games
sources.used_for: Texture settings referenced by the Unreal setup steps (sRGB, compression, mip generation, filtering, tiling).
sources.guide: Texture settings for the Unreal setup steps: sRGB, compression, mip generation, filtering and tiling.

sources.title: The Color Atlas — Munsell Hue, Value and Chroma
sources.author: A. H. Munsell
sources.used_for: Hue/Value/Chroma organization and H V/C notation. Interactive tree is original app work using the existing bundled renotation display samples; geometry is schematic, not an OKLab plot.
sources.guide: Hue, Value and Chroma organization and H V/C notation.

app_assets.title: Codex Use Esse default Preview assets
app_assets.kind: User-provided assets and app design choice
app_assets.used_for: Explosion_Emissive.png, Explosion_Smoke.png and BG.png supplied on 2026-10-14; top-to-bottom order and Add emissive blend explicitly requested. Embedded offline fallback and Data seed are app implementation choices.

app_assets.title: User Munsell diagram reference
app_assets.kind: User-provided visual reference and original app implementation
app_assets.used_for: Hue ring, neutral Value column and numbered radial Chroma layout inspired by Screenshot_2026-10-14_at_12.38.56.png. Diagram is drawn in canvas with bundled samples; schematic geometry does not replace the editor’s OKLab implementation.

app_assets.title: Color Atlas editor graph illustration
app_assets.used_for: Passive copy of the editor’s actual OKLab SVG in Reading the 3D view; no external artwork. Includes the rendered sRGB cloud, current lightness plane and numbered ramp.

app_assets.title: Online import budgets
app_assets.used_for: 64 MiB library JSON pre-read limit; bounded collection counts;20 MiB compressed PNG/JPEG/WebP,8192px maximum edge and32MP maximum dimensions. These are app choices, not browser standards.

maintenance_sources.used_for: Remove unused remote script allowances and unsafe-eval; preserve embedded inline app scripts and opaque iframe.
Secret scanning, push protection, dependency updates and repository security controls.
